landUse.title: Miami-Dade existing land use
landUse.note: County LU code and description. Rings were returned in WGS84 and projected to the site origin in international feet. Vertices are rounded to the nearest foot, then a vertex closer than 2 ft to the previous kept vertex is dropped. The rings were not rebuilt on 2026-11-07. A study group follows the county description. It is not an inferred intensity.

geometry.originalNote: County LU code and description. Rings are projected to the site origin and simplified to an 8 ft vertex spacing. A study group follows the county description. It is not an inferred intensity.
geometry.featureIds: The service response contained no OBJECTID. Stored ids lu-1 onward are sequence labels, not county feature identifiers.
geometry.countyEditDate: Not returned by the query and not stored.
geometry.reproduction: All 318 stored rings match the archived WGS84 extract after nearest-foot rounding and a 2 ft vertex drop. The earlier 8 ft note does not describe the stored geometry: 12,094 segments are shorter than 8 ft, and none are shorter than 2 ft.

parks.title: Miami-Dade ParkFinder
parks.note: Three municipal ParkFinder points fall in this window. The county park-boundary layer returned no features here. Distances are to the ParkFinder point. The stored name City Cementary is the county spelling. ADA fields were not used.

osm.title: OpenStreetMap named public destinations
osm.note: Named features with an amenity, tourism, leisure, or building tag in the kept set. A name without one of those tags is not a land use.
